caption: The drawing depicts a carved, wood-textured sculpture rendered entirely in shades of brown, resembling a bas-relief. The main composition consists of two large human profiles facing opposite directions, forming the left and right edges of the sculpture. Between the profiles, two full-length human figures are positioned in the center, both facing slightly toward the viewer but angled away from each other. The left figure, with one raised arm and an open hand, appears to be in a startled or defensive pose. The right figure holds the left figure's hand while the other arm is raised, appearing to place a hand on the head of the profile on the right. Above the central figures, an eight-pointed star or flower-like motif is visible. The entire composition sits atop a woodgrain-patterned pedestal or base, enhancing the carved, wooden effect. The background is a plain, uncolored surface, and the drawing is signed "A. Loyd" at the lower right.
title: Symbolic Figure Carvings
